articles.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin swings to $126 million profit but misses revenue estimates
articles.snippet: Revenue fell to $63.4 million in the third quarter and missed analysts’ forecasts as bitcoin production declined and higher summer electricity prices pushed mining costs up.

articles.title: Trump Media moves $342 million in bitcoin to Crypto.com, blockchain data show
articles.snippet: A wallet supposedly linked to Trump Media has made a large BTC transfer to Crypto.com, data tracked by Arkham show.

articles.title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI
articles.snippet: The Eric Trump-backed miner reported $126 million in quarterly net income, largely driven by gains on its Bitcoin holdings, despite rising mining costs and shrinking margins.

articles.title: Trump’s memecoin ventures derailed CLARITY Act, Scaramucci says
articles.snippet: The SkyBridge founder said disputes over ethics restrictions also stalled negotiations, with both sides responsible for the setback.

articles.title: ‘Lawyer up’: Democrats target Trump, Big Tech after midterm sweep
articles.snippet: Democrats wasted little time after their midterm victory, warning tech CEOs to prepare for subpoenas and signaling fresh investigations into Trump’s business dealings.
